arguments.command:
cd /app/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/dev')
from perf import gen_stream_big, make_borders
rnd = random.Random(13)
U = 2147483648
borders = make_borders(rnd, 32, U)
# 40000 steps, 3 arrivals each = 120000, 32-char ids, indent=4
steps=[]
cnt=0
t=0
for k in range(40000):
    t += rnd.randint(1,5)
    lanes = rnd.sample(range(8),3)
    arr=[]
    for l in lanes:
        arr.append({'id':'packet-identifier-%015d'%cnt,'lane':l,'rank':rnd.randrange(U)})
        cnt+=1
    steps.append({'t':t,'serve':True,'arrivals':arr})
req={'mode':'stream','banks':16,'lanes':8,'limit':U,'borders':borders,'capacity':20000,'epoch':3,'steps':steps}
s=json.dumps(req, indent=4)
print('MiB', len(s)/1048576)
open('/app/dev/huge_stream.json','w').write(s)
EOF
ls -l /app/dev/huge_stream.json; python3 /app/dev/mem.py /app/dev/huge_stream.json
